entries.name: NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression

uncoveredRegionBehavior: Show the selected-language help guide and contact template. Explain the coverage gap and suggest contacting local primary care or public health services; do not infer a country from language or fabricate a provider.
externalLinkBehavior: Open only after user action. Do not transmit answers, scores, health concerns or notes. Show the destination region and actual website language when verified; otherwise state that language availability is unverified.
